title: onboard-astra-70b-v1.0: metadata, perf profiles, and changelog automation
author: Ethan Liu
description:
Onboard Astra-70B v1.0 into the model registry and add initial performance profiles + automated changelog/release-note generation. Motivation: Astra-70B is a community model with strong instruction-following characteristics and good throughput on A100/MI200 class hardware. We need a canonical registry entry, validated perf profiles for our serving runtime, and an automated changelog pipeline so model releases produce release notes for the Console and release feed.

What this PR does:
- Adds metadata.yaml for models/astra-70b/v1.0 including model family, architecture hints, tokenizer, licensing, and recommended quantization profiles.
- Adds perf_profiles.json with measured throughput/latency profiles for typical sequence-length distributions (chat/assist/default) across target hardware (A100-40G, A100-80G, MI250). Profiles include observed median P50/P95 latencies and throughput tokens/sec and a note about KV cache behavior.
- Adds unit/integration test for loading profiles and a lightweight inference sanity check (tests/models/astra-70b/test_inference_profile.py).
- Adds changelog generator script (scripts/changelog-gen/generate_model_release_notes.py) that consumes metadata and perf_profiles and emits a markdown release note snippet. Hooked into CI to produce artifact on tagged release.
- Updates docs/models.md with an entry for Astra-70B and an example of quantization recommendations.
- Adds CI workflow change to run perf-profile validation and changelog generation on PRs that touch models/* and to publish release notes artifact on model release tags.

Checklist (checked):
- [x] Metadata YAML present and validated against schema
- [x] Perf profiles included for main hardware targets
- [x] Tests added and passing locally
- [x] Changelog generation script with basic template
- [x] Docs updated

Commits (summary):
- Add metadata and initial perf profiles for Astra-70B v1.0
- Add unit/integration tests for model profile validation
- Add changelog generation script and CI integration
- Docs: add Astra-70B entry and quantization guidance

Changed files (high-level):
- models/astra-70b/v1.0/metadata.yaml (new)
- models/astra-70b/v1.0/perf_profiles.json (new)
- tests/models/astra-70b/test_inference_profile.py (new)
- scripts/changelog-gen/generate_model_release_notes.py (new)
- ci/workflows/model-registry.yml (modified) - adds perf validation and changelog artifact step
- scripts/ci/perf-check.sh (new helper)
- docs/models.md (modified)

Notes: perf_profiles.json contains measured numbers (P50/P95) collected from benchmark-lab runs; values are annotated with timestamp and hardware tag. The changelog generator uses a minimal Jinja template and will be expanded in follow-ups to support localized release notes and Console integration.

Risk and rollout plan: this change is low-risk to serving runtime (no runtime code changes). CI now validates that new model entries have metadata and at least one perf profile to prevent incomplete onboarding. For production release we'll tag models/astra-70b/v1.0 with a model-release tag which triggers release-note artifact generation and creates a Console draft entry (separate follow-up to wire the Console API).
